SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.shipping_fee), 2) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Sums shipping_fee from marts.fct_orders for orders with status 'completed' and order_date in calendar year 2025. I assumed the status value is exactly 'completed' and that order_date is the date used to assign orders to 2025. I did not verify the status values against the data, so check that 'completed' matches the stored value.
